The '''Slayers Three''' was a trio of hunters from the [[Spawn Nebula/Legends|Spawn Nebula]]&mdash;[[Angol Martilla|Angol]], [[Bez Martilla|Bez]], and [[Derrus Martilla]]. The three siblings regularly left their home and ventured out into [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] in search of the glory of the hunt; they followed an unknown calendar system and traveled to worlds decreed by their [[Shaman/Legends|shamans]]. Around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Battle of Rishi]], the trio arrived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]].
